**In one line**: The New York Times bundled OpenAI's development pause, an "Artificial State" threat argument, and a look at AI reasoning into a single episode.

### Key points
- The episode reportedly centers on OpenAI's "Two-Week Pause" in development.
- Harvard historian Jill Lepore weighs in on the threat of what she calls the "Artificial State."
- A "Train of Thought" segment examines how AI models reason and process their outputs.

### Why it matters
How major AI labs pace their development, and how AI reshapes states and institutions, sit at the center of the regulation debate. The piece reflects mainstream media weighing social and political fallout alongside technical progress.
